name: Bolt
summary: AI web app builder from StackBlitz.

flows.title: Make a visual edit in the preview
steps: Open your Bolt project and click Select in the chatbox.
Point at the element you want in the preview — Bolt highlights each one as you hover — and click it. The selection appears above the chatbox together with the toolbar.
Double-click text to edit it in place, or adjust the properties the toolbar offers for that element, such as font size, alignment or colour.
Click Add changes to put the edit into the batch. A marker then appears on the element.
Keep selecting elements and adding edits, then click Save changes for Bolt to apply the whole batch to your project's code.

flows.title: Attach a file to the chat
steps: In the chatbox, click the plus icon.
Click Attach file, then choose your file.
An agents.md file added this way is found and used automatically.

flows.title: Clear a project's context
steps: Click Clear context in the menu that appears.
Bolt still reaches your codebase and files afterwards, but reads them as if for the first time, with no memory of the recent chat history.
Project knowledge is kept: it lives outside the conversation and survives a context reset.
